tasks.name: adjust_bottle
tasks.instruction: Pick up the bottle on the table head-up with the correct arm

tasks.name: beat_block_hammer
tasks.instruction: there is a hammer and a block on the table, use the arm to <grab the hammer> and <beat the block>

tasks.name: blocks_ranking_rgb
tasks.instruction: <Place> the red block, green block, and blue block <in the order> of red, green, and blue from left to right, <placing in a row>.

tasks.name: blocks_ranking_size
tasks.instruction: there are three blocks on the table, the color of the blocks is random, move the blocks to the center of the table, and arrange them from largest to smallest, from left to right

tasks.name: click_alarmclock
tasks.instruction: click the alarm clock's center of the top side button on the table

tasks.name: click_bell
tasks.instruction: click the <bell's top center> on the table

tasks.name: dump_bin_bigbin
tasks.instruction: Grab the small bin and pour the balls into the big bin

tasks.name: grab_roller
tasks.instruction: use both arms to grab the roller on the table

tasks.name: handover_block
tasks.instruction: use the left arm to grasp the red block on the table, handover it to the right arm and place it on the blue pad

tasks.name: handover_mic
tasks.instruction: Use one arm to grasp the microphone on the table and handover it to the other arm

tasks.name: hanging_mug
tasks.instruction: Use left arm to pick the mug on the table, rotate the mug and put the mug down in the middle of the table, use the right arm to pick the mug and hang it onto the rack.

tasks.name: lift_pot
tasks.instruction: use BOTH!!! arms to lift the pot

tasks.name: move_can_pot
tasks.instruction: there is a can and a pot on the table, use one arm to <pick up the can> and <move it to beside the pot>

tasks.name: move_pillbottle_pad
tasks.instruction: Use one arm to pick the pillbottle and place it onto the pad.

tasks.name: move_playingcard_away
tasks.instruction: use the arm to <pick up the playing card> and <move it away from the table>.For example, if the playing card is on the outward side of the table, you should move it further outward side of the table.

tasks.name: move_stapler_pad
tasks.instruction: use appropriate arm to move the stapler to a colored mat

tasks.name: open_laptop
tasks.instruction: use one arm to open the laptop

tasks.name: open_microwave
tasks.instruction: Use one arm to open the microwave.

tasks.name: pick_diverse_bottles
tasks.instruction: simultaneously pick up the two different bottles, one with each arm

tasks.name: pick_dual_bottles
tasks.instruction: simultaneously pick up one bottle with each arm

tasks.name: place_a2b_left
tasks.instruction: use appropriate arm to place object A on the left of object B

tasks.name: place_a2b_right
tasks.instruction: use appropriate arm to place object A on the right of object B

tasks.name: place_bread_basket
tasks.instruction: place every bread on the table into the basket, using the available arm or arms

tasks.name: place_bread_skillet
tasks.instruction: use one arm to lift and hold the skillet while the other arm places the bread into it

tasks.name: place_burger_fries
tasks.instruction: simultaneously pick up the hamburger and fries with both arms, then place both foods on the tray

tasks.name: place_can_basket
tasks.instruction: use one arm to pick up the can, put it into the basket, and use another arm to lift the basket

tasks.name: place_cans_plasticbox
tasks.instruction: simultaneously pick up both cans with separate arms, then place the left can and right can into the plastic box

tasks.name: place_container_plate
tasks.instruction: place the container onto the plate

tasks.name: place_dual_shoes
tasks.instruction: use both arms to pick up the two shoes on the table and put them in the shoebox, with the shoe tip pointing to the left

tasks.name: place_empty_cup
tasks.instruction: use an arm to place the empty cup on the coaster

tasks.name: place_fan
tasks.instruction: grab the fan and place it on a colored mat, <make sure the fan is facing the robot!(THIS MUST BE REFERRED TO>

tasks.name: place_mouse_pad
tasks.instruction: grab the mouse and place it on a colored mat

tasks.name: place_object_basket
tasks.instruction: use one arm to grab the target object and put it in the basket, then use the other arm to grab the basket, and finally move the basket slightly away

tasks.name: place_object_scale
tasks.instruction: use one arm to grab the object and put it on the scale

tasks.name: place_object_stand
tasks.instruction: use appropriate arm to place the object on the stand

tasks.name: place_phone_stand
tasks.instruction: pick up the phone and put it on the phone stand

tasks.name: place_shoe
tasks.instruction: use one arm to grab the shoe from the table and place it on the mat

tasks.name: press_stapler
tasks.instruction: Use one arm to press the stapler.

tasks.name: put_bottles_dustbin
tasks.instruction: use arms to grab the bottles and put them into the dustbin to the left of the table

tasks.name: put_object_cabinet
tasks.instruction: use one arm to hold the object and the other arm to open the cabinet drawer, then place the object inside

tasks.name: rotate_qrcode
tasks.instruction: Use arm to catch the qrcode board on the table, pick it up, rotate to let the qrcode face towards you, then put it back on the table and release it

tasks.name: scan_object
tasks.instruction: simultaneously pick up the scanner and the object with separate arms, then scan the object

tasks.name: shake_bottle
tasks.instruction: Shake the bottle with proper arm

tasks.name: shake_bottle_horizontally
tasks.instruction: Shake the bottle horizontally with proper arm

tasks.name: stack_blocks_three
tasks.instruction: build a three-block stack at the center by placing the red block first, the green block on red, and the blue block on green

tasks.name: stack_blocks_two
tasks.instruction: there are two blocks on the table, the color of the blocks is <red, green>, <move the blocks to the center of the table>, and <stack the geen block on the red block>

tasks.name: stack_bowls_three
tasks.instruction: stack the three bowls on top of each other

tasks.name: stack_bowls_two
tasks.instruction: stack the two bowls on top of each other

tasks.name: stamp_seal
tasks.instruction: Grab the stamp and stamp onto the specific color mat

tasks.name: turn_switch
tasks.instruction: use the robotic arm to click the switch
